notes: Firmware 1.1.4 / Web 1.1.10 / broker: the MQTT owner never waits inside a stalled write (arduino-esp32 closed the socket after 5 s) - frames go out only when the socket is writable, control frames queue, periodic frames drop; reconnect ladder 0.5-1 s .. 60 s with equal jitter that resets only after a stable link; supervisor re-init no longer tears down a healthy link (unsigned beat/now race) and adds no backoff step; the daily firmware check waits while the Web is in use; config/reported is resumable, debounced and capacity-aware; advisory 'received' acks are shed first; Wi-Fi disconnect reasons are logged and a driver-reported failure ends the connect wait after 4 s; STA flap guard 3 s. Broker: a dropped device socket is announced as presence {online:false,state:'reconnecting'} for PRESENCE_GRACE_MS (75 s) before the final offline; Web shows 'KẾT NỐI LẠI', keeps the last data and holds one light click until the machine is back. Control/safety/thermal/OTA policy unchanged. Web 1.1.10 also carries the Smart AutoTune / PID work merged from claude/smart-autotune-v1: read-only PID Monitor (live numbers + charts), AutoTune stage/result/failure reason, and a Kỹ thuật PID section that exists only while the HMI grants it and needs the 4-digit technical PIN; the Web never saves PID itself (the machine shows old/new and waits for CÓ/KHÔNG, 60 s). Firmware 1.1.4 also includes the fast, honest boot (Home only for a valid stable sensor, 30 s diagnostic, no splash timeout) and the single Wi-Fi state machine with a 30 s stability window.
